1.explanation:
1. Pagination.js: this is where the footer string is constructed (around lines 148 and 312 in the React implementation). We need to introduce conditional logic here to check if max === 1 or totalPages === 1 and choose the singular noun.
2. Pagination.test.js: the existing unit tests assume only plural labels. We must add or update tests to cover the singular case so that we don’t regress.
3. pagination.config.js: the default text tokens for "item(s)" and "page(s)" live in this config. We need to make sure there are singular and plural entries, and expose them to the React component so it can pick the right form based on the count.
1.bug_scenario: In the Pagination component’s footer text, when there is exactly one item or one page the UI still renders the plural labels (“items” and “pages”). For example “1–1 of 1 items” should read “1–1 of 1 item”, and when there is only a single page it should read “1–1 of 1 page.”

2.explanation:
• packages/react/src/components/Pagination/Pagination.js is the main React implementation where the footer text is composed using totalItems, max (items per page) and totalPages. This is where the conditional logic for singular vs. plural must be added.  
• packages/react/src/components/Pagination/experimental/Pagination.js contains the experimental variant of the same component and needs the same fix.  
• packages/components/src/components/pagination/pagination.config.js defines the default strings for “item(s) per page” and “of X page(s).” It may need new singular variants or a function to choose based on count.  
• packages/components/src/components/pagination/pagination.js is the unstyled vanilla JavaScript component; it parallels the React logic and likewise must handle singular forms.  
• packages/react/src/components/Pagination/Pagination-test.js contains the unit tests for the Pagination component; tests need to be updated or added to assert correct singular text when max===1 or totalPages===1.
2.bug_scenario: When there is exactly one item or exactly one page, the footer in the Pagination component still reads “items” or “pages” (plural). The report and screenshot show “1 items per page” and “1 of 1 pages,” but it should read “1 item per page” and “1 of 1 page.”
